blocks.text: This video shows a friendly page for a missing link, with a boat on a moving sea. It is two animations, layered with a few lines of styles. Our page already says what happened, and offers a way back. Let's add the sea at the bottom.

blocks.alt: The sea file repeats forever. The style pins it to the bottom of the scene.

blocks.text: The sea file repeats forever. The style pins it to the bottom of the scene. Now the boat, on top of the sea.

blocks.alt: The boat is a second file, drawn over the sea. Each one plays on its own, and together they read as one picture.

blocks.text: The boat is a second file, drawn over the sea. Each one plays on its own, and together they read as one picture. So, two small files and a few lines of styles. Layers let each part move in its own way.
